title: Buga Sphere given to Jaime Maussan

tellings.quote: So, Jaime Maussan was given this thing. It was taken in Buga, Colombia. That's why it's called the Buga Sphere.
visiting Jaime, he happened to have recovered an aluminum object, of which he had over 4 minutes of video flying around Buga, Colombia.
tellings.difference: Adds over 4 minutes of video of the object flying around Buga and the fact that it was scanned at Maussan's.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Buga sphere from Buga, Colombia coming into Jaime Maussan's hands in Mexico City in 2025, as Jesse saw firsthand.

as_told.title: Buga sphere recovered and scanned at Jaime Maussan's

plain: Jesse Michels says that when he visited the Mexican UFO journalist Jaime Maussan in 2025, Maussan had been given a metal object called the Buga Sphere, named after Buga, the Colombian town where it was taken. On one telling Michels describes it as an aluminum object that Maussan had recovered, with more than four minutes of video showing it flying around Buga, and he says it was scanned at Maussan's place. Michels tells this as something he saw himself, and if it is what Maussan says, it would be a flying object that someone could actually hold and examine.
